description: This file contains zlib wrapper functions for error handling, initialization, deflation, and inflation, specifically tailored for use within the Git project. It manages zlib streams, error messages, and buffer capacities.

methods.name: zerr_to_string
methods.description: Converts zlib error status codes to human-readable strings.

methods.name: zlib_pre_call
methods.description: Prepares zlib stream for operation by copying relevant fields.

methods.name: zlib_post_call
methods.description: Updates stream state after zlib operation, checking for consistency.

methods.name: git_inflate_init_gzip_only
methods.description: Initializes inflate stream for gzip only.

methods.name: git_inflate
methods.description: Performs inflation with zlib, handling buffer and error states.

methods.name: git_deflate_bound
methods.description: Calculates maximum compressed size for a given input.

methods.name: do_git_deflate_init
methods.description: Helper for initializing deflate with specific window bits.

methods.name: git_deflate_init_gzip
methods.description: Initializes deflate stream for gzip compression.

methods.name: git_deflate_init_raw
methods.description: Initializes deflate stream for raw compression.

methods.name: git_deflate
methods.description: Performs deflation with zlib, handling buffer and error states.
